messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-07-09] handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags: Quick one: the flags service belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to Atlas for running it until now.
- [2025-09-29] handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags: Feature-flags has a new home: team Boreal. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Feature-flags lives with Atlas.
- [2026-02-24] handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags: Quick one: the flags service belongs to the Cinder team starting today. Thanks to the Boreal team for running it until now.
- [2025-08-26] handover/2025-08-26-event-bus: The bus has a new home: Cinder. The Atlas team kept it until today.
- [2025-07-28] standup/cinder/2025-07-28: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.
- [2026-02-10] handover/2026-02-10-reporting: The reports pipeline has a new home: the Cinder team. Ember kept it until today.
- [2025-09-23] standup/cinder/2025-09-23: Cinder has switched to trunk-based development.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The indexer lives with the Cinder team.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-09-05] handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-08-29: the scheduler went to Atlas, not team Cinder. Team Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-07-03] standup/cinder/2025-07-03: The Cinder team saw that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-06-23] standup/cinder/2025-06-23: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2026-01-05] standup/cinder/2026-01-05: Observation from the Cinder team: after the retention change, Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-08-29] handover/2025-08-29-scheduler: Ownership change: the scheduler now sits with team Cinder. Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-07-28] standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2: Heads-up from Cinder: the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. Observation from team Cinder: after the dependency bump, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-08-27] standup/cinder/2025-08-27: The search indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11; the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. Cinder sits on the third floor.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-02-21] standup/cinder/2025-02-21: Rotation day for team Cinder: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez. Team Cinder saw that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-01-01] standup/cinder/2026-01-01: The Cinder team noticed that the search indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2: Heads-up from Atlas: the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-04-03] handover/2025-04-03-event-bus: Ownership change: the event bus now sits with the Atlas team. The Boreal team no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-13] handover/2025-11-13-ledger: The ledger has a new home: team Ember. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-catalog: From today the pager for the catalog service rings Dune, not the Cinder team. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-03-31] standup/ember/2026-03-31: Diego Alvarez has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. Ember saw that the feature flag service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.

Question: Why was feature-flags moved from Atlas to Cinder?
